[[Mitth'raw'nuruodo|Thrawn]] graduated from [[Taharim Academy]] around [[37 BBY]] per the following reasoning. ''[[Thrawn Ascendancy: Lesser Evil]]'' establishes that Thrawn was a [[cadet]] at the Academy for two [[Standard year|years]]. Per the reasoning [[Template:WhenThrassMetThrawnDate|here]], Thrawn entered the academy around [[39 BBY]]. Therefore, he must have graduated as a [[lieutenant]] in the [[Chiss Expansionary Defense Fleet]] around 37 [['ABY-BBY' dating system|BBY]]. Thrawn and [[Mitth'ras'safis|Thrass]] met the [[Stybla family]] [[Senior Aide]] [[Stybla'ppin'cykok|Lappincyk]] on [[Naporar]] just after his graduation, placing their encounter in the [[Unidentified bistro (Naporar)|bistro]] around 37 BBY as well.<noinclude>
